description: NousResearch Hermes Agent dashboard — self-improving personal AI with memory, skills, and 200+ models. Backend runs persistently in WSL2.
notes:
The Hermes backend (gateway + dashboard) runs persistently in WSL2 Docker. This workspace opens a browser pointing at the Hermes dashboard on the host.

First-time setup: the hermes and hermes-dashboard containers must be running in WSL2. See /opt/hermes-agent/ for the compose files.

go.cmd: bash -c "if ! curl -sf --max-time 3 http://172.17.0.1:19500/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker rm -f kasm-setup-trigger 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name kasm-setup-trigger --restart unless-stopped -p 172.17.0.1:19500:19500 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v /root/.openclaw:/data/openclaw -v /root/.hermes:/data/hermes -e DATA_DIR=/data ghcr.io/perspective0labs/kasm-setup-trigger:latest; sleep 5; fi; curl -sf --max-time 20 http://172.17.0.1:19500/ensure-hermes || true; DISPLAY=:1 chromium-browser --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --app=http://172.17.0.1:9119 2>/dev/null"
